workstreams.title: Release and deployment
workstreams.support: Backend engineer, web engineer and QA
workstreams.depends: Launch scope decisions D01 and D02
workstreams.outcome: One clean source revision produces the same identifiable web and API release that QA certifies on HTTPS staging.

tasks.title: Declare the active release sources
work: Declare edutech_backend, edutech_web and nexora_student_mobile as active roots; retain Flutter and the nested mirror as archives until removal is separately scoped.
Record current local/main/stage SHAs, lockfiles, runtime versions and migration inventories without copying secrets.
Create an integration branch and review the existing dirty changes; preserve the stage-applied economy migration and its model fields.
acceptance: A clean integration commit contains the required main/candidate histories and preserves applied migrations.
The active release manifest identifies code, dependencies and configuration ownership.
verification: Compare migration files and applied history against an isolated staging database clone.
Run system checks, model/migration checks and focused migration/route regressions.
tasks.status_note: Local evidence is recorded in the W01 execution report; live staging and formal dependent gates remain separate.

tasks.title: Build reproducible release artifacts
work: Run backend, web and mobile static gates from the clean commit.
Build one immutable release artifact with source SHA, dependency digests and environment identity.
Expose matching non-secret provenance in backend health and web response headers.
acceptance: CI refuses dirty or unidentified candidates and records artifact digests.
Web and API runtime identity matches the requested candidate; no build reports local.
verification: Execute release-manifest/pipeline contract tests.
Compare the running headers/health with the archived manifest.
tasks.status_note: Local evidence is recorded in the W01 execution report; live staging and formal dependent gates remain separate.

tasks.title: Correct and verify HTTPS routing
work: Review effective shared-host nginx configuration before applying the existing remediations.
Verify intended hostname, redirects, API routes, schema/docs and Django-admin separation.
Verify certificate, trusted origins, cookie attributes and unknown-host rejection.
acceptance: Expected routes resolve without loops; unknown hosts do not reach an unintended application.
Login and refresh work through HTTPS with the intended cookie and origin policies.
verification: Run deployment entrypoint checks and focused browser provenance/security gates.
Retain sanitized headers and effective configuration digest.
tasks.status_note: Local evidence is recorded in the W01 execution report; live staging and formal dependent gates remain separate.

tasks.title: Certify the deployed assessment lifecycle
work: Run the disposable institute/account/import/build/assign/start/save/submit/result journey on the exact HTTPS candidate.
Include anonymous, draft, inactive assignment, unassigned student, future/expired window, cross-student and cross-tenant denials.
Clean up exact synthetic fixtures and record both archive behavior and any deliberate purge.
acceptance: Correct score, rank and result visibility agree across browser/API/database.
No critical negative path fails and fixture cleanup is independently verified.
verification: Retain trace, screenshots, API/database assertions and candidate manifest together.
Require the deployed result, not a local-only pass.
tasks.status_note: Local evidence is recorded in the W01 execution report; live staging and formal dependent gates remain separate.

tasks.title: Rehearse promotion and rollback
work: Run a staged promotion and health verification using the release runbook.
Rehearse rollback in an isolated environment with a migration-compatible database strategy.
Record recovery owner, trigger, elapsed recovery time and known rollback limits.
acceptance: A release can be identified, promoted and recovered using the runbook.
Pilot release approval references the exact candidate and its test evidence.
verification: Perform the rollback rehearsal without affecting real learners.
Verify web/API/data consistency after recovery.
tasks.status_note: Full isolated database/media/web/API rollback and forward recovery passed. Live promotion and approved operational recovery targets remain pending.

workstreams.title: Access and tenant policies
workstreams.depends: D03 teacher collaboration, D04 archive behavior and D05 public exam model
workstreams.outcome: Each role can act only on the agreed institute, learner and content scope, including after tenant suspension.

tasks.title: Freeze the access contract
work: Define platform, institute, teacher, student and parent read/write scope for roster, questions, exams, attempts, grades and money.
Choose institute-wide teacher collaboration or assignment-limited access explicitly.
Separate archive/hide, suspend access and delete semantics; define effects on active attempts and parent visibility.
acceptance: A reviewed role/resource matrix states both permitted and denied operations.
Suspension behavior preserves saved answers and defines whether active attempts may finish.
verification: Review examples with two teachers, two cohorts, two institutes, two students and a linked/unlinked parent.

tasks.title: Enforce tenant and account state
work: Apply the agreed tenant-state checks centrally to protected reads/writes.
Handle login, refresh and existing sessions consistently when an institute is suspended.
Preserve the audit trail and provide an explicit recovery/reactivation action.
acceptance: A suspended tenant cannot continue ordinary protected operations through an old session.
Active exam behavior matches the approved interruption policy; reactivation is controlled and audited.
verification: Use synthetic active/suspended tenants to test password login, refresh, existing access token and direct API calls.
Verify no saved answers are destroyed by suspension.

tasks.title: Align teacher and parent scope
tasks.gate: Pilot for teacher; parent gate if offered
work: Apply the chosen teacher contract to collections, detail routes, CRUD, builder, grading, monitoring, reports and exports.
Check parent relationship status and per-child permissions on every child-specific endpoint.
Replace UI wording that claims narrower scope than the API enforces.
acceptance: Two disjoint teacher assignments behave exactly as the chosen contract specifies.
Revoked, suspended or unrelated parent links do not expose child information.
verification: Execute direct API and browser negative matrices, including forged identifiers and exports.

tasks.title: Resolve public exam eligibility
tasks.gate: Public web if platform exams are offered
work: Choose institute-local copies or a controlled cross-institute platform-exam access path.
Define academic mapping, assignment, entitlement, reporting ownership and allowed learner populations.
Implement the selected path without weakening ordinary tenant isolation.
acceptance: A private-institute learner can discover, unlock if required, take and review an eligible platform exam.
An ineligible learner is rejected at discovery/detail/start, and results remain learner-scoped.
verification: Run a fresh public-hub plus private-institute fixture through the complete result lifecycle.

tasks.title: Certify authorization on the release candidate
work: Bind the agreed access matrix to executable cases and the release SHA.
Include stale sessions, inactive profiles/assignments, exports, manual grade actions and economy mutations.
Run the public-exam cases separately when W02.04 enters release scope.
acceptance: No unresolved critical access defect exists for a feature included in the release.
Every exclusion is reflected in route/API availability and customer promises.
verification: Run focused backend denial tests and real HTTPS browser role/tenant tests.

workstreams.title: Assessment workflows
workstreams.depends: W02 access contract and W05 pilot content selection
workstreams.outcome: Teachers can reliably deliver the included assessments and students receive correct, safely published results.

tasks.title: Stabilize the objective assessment baseline
work: Freeze the pilot question types, exam policies and reporting fields; recommended initial scope is objective exams.
Keep deterministic scoring/negative-marking fixtures and result/publication expectations.
Cover assignment changes, shuffled questions/options, duplicate saves/submits and stale answer requests.
acceptance: Included question types score correctly and produce one final result per intended attempt policy.
Published/review-visible information matches the configured release policy.
verification: Run backend scoring contracts and the fresh full browser lifecycle without weakening assertions.

tasks.title: Resolve teacher results navigation
work: Reproduce the failed exam-selection click under production web builds.
Inspect client hydration, pending navigation, data reload and event/locator timing.
Fix the confirmed product or harness cause while retaining real click-based coverage.
acceptance: Repeated exam selections and browser refresh retain the expected exam context.
The previously failed flow passes three consecutive isolated runs and one representative role pack.
verification: Keep both failing and corrected traces; verify URL, selected exam and rendered data agree.

tasks.title: Prove answer and session recovery
work: Test refresh/reload, connection loss before and after save acknowledgment, token expiry, duplicate requests and lost submit responses.
Use server-authoritative timing and explicit saved/saving/failed states.
Document recovery when an exam window ends or a service restarts; do not promise fully offline examination.
acceptance: Acknowledged answers survive recovery and timed-out work cannot extend the exam incorrectly.
Submission retries cannot create duplicate grading or double consumption of access allowances.
verification: Run long-session and interrupted-network fixtures on web; reuse the API contracts in W08 mobile testing.

tasks.title: Certify descriptive grading if included
work: Cover reviewer assignment/claiming, rubric marks, recheck, moderation and unauthorized reviewers.
Verify pending grades block or qualify result publication as intended.
Regenerate rankings/analytics after approved grade changes with an audit trail.
acceptance: A descriptive answer reaches its correct reviewed result without early disclosure or lost grading history.
Unsupported review variants are disabled for the pilot if this gate is deferred.
verification: Run a populated manual-review browser journey and backend moderation/result regressions.

tasks.title: Reconcile learner reports and notifications
tasks.gate: Pilot for results; broader release for optional alerts
work: Compare attempt summary, result list, leaderboard and analytics totals against deterministic fixtures.
Verify empty, pending review, unpublished, failed and completed states.
Test notification/parent alert generation, link targets and permission behavior only for enabled channels.
acceptance: Core result data is internally consistent and every active action leads to the correct learner/exam.
Charts and recommendations explain insufficient-data states and avoid implying unsupported predictions.
verification: Capture browser/API/database comparisons and enabled notification delivery evidence.

workstreams.pilot_scope: Objective exams only, confirmed 21 October; descriptive grading excluded. Actual curriculum, content and policy restrictions still require W05 approval.

workstreams.title: Web UI and UX
workstreams.effort: 8–14 engineering days plus design and user sessions
workstreams.depends: W02 role contract and W03 included exam workflow
workstreams.outcome: Each role reaches its main task quickly through readable, bounded screens on desktop and mobile web.

tasks.title: Define role tasks and simplify navigation
work: Map first-use and repeat-use tasks for institute admin, teacher, student and parent web.
Prioritize student continue/start exam, teacher find-question/create exam and institute roster/setup readiness.
Preserve the component system; remove redundant banners, repeated metrics and ambiguous active navigation.
acceptance: Each core screen has one clear primary action and a concise explanation of any blocked state.
Role navigation labels match the actual product tasks.
verification: Review desktop and 390 px mobile task flows with a designer and QA before implementation.

tasks.title: Make question and wallet lists bounded
tasks.gate: Pilot for question bank; commerce gate for wallet
work: Default question bank to compact inventory with search, pagination and collapsed advanced filters.
Move licensing and entitlement explanations into contextual help and specific action blockers.
Paginate wallet orders/ledger; keep balance and the next useful action near the top.
acceptance: Rendered history/list size stays bounded as records grow; all records remain reachable.
Filter/reset/pagination retain scope and do not silently change counts or selections.
verification: Test empty, small and hundreds-of-record fixtures; capture desktop/mobile before-and-after measurements.
Have a teacher find and add a question without coaching.

tasks.title: Shorten exam creation
work: Use a recommended audience → questions → schedule → preview/publish path.
Offer a few pilot-appropriate presets and defer timing/security/economy details behind advanced settings.
Keep marks, question availability and publish blockers visible without repeated summary panels.
acceptance: A teacher creates the pilot exam without navigating advanced commercial or runtime concepts.
Preview, saved configuration and student runtime remain equivalent.
verification: Run standard and advanced creation regressions, validation errors and mobile form checks.

tasks.title: Improve learner and signup activation
work: Reduce mobile header height and place continue/assigned work ahead of diagnostic cards.
Bring role selection and signup form together; shorten explanatory content.
Use plain-language loading, empty, error, locked and pending states with a specific recovery action.
acceptance: The main learner action or a truthful next step is visible in the first meaningful viewport.
Signup, profile completion and first assigned exam have a continuous understandable route.
verification: Run first-use tasks with unfamiliar learners and capture blocked/error-state screenshots.

tasks.title: Certify accessible responsive tasks
tasks.gate: Pilot for critical tasks; broader release for full included surface
work: Check keyboard order, visible focus, labels, error announcements, dialogs, screen reader basics, zoom and contrast.
Test critical exam/forms in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit plus target mobile browsers.
Check long names, equations, media and translations where offered.
acceptance: Critical tasks have no unresolved accessibility or responsive blocker.
Mobile navigation and error recovery work without hidden/clipped controls.
verification: Retain automated checks and manual keyboard/screen-reader/device evidence separately; no blanket WCAG claim from five keyboard tests.

execution_findings.finding: Existing desktop student header controls overlap in the 1280x720 result receipt; verify responsive, keyboard and zoom layouts.

workstreams.title: Content and shared library
workstreams.support: Backend engineer, content reviewers and QA
workstreams.effort: 3–6 engineering days plus curriculum review effort
workstreams.depends: D01 first customer segment and curriculum
workstreams.outcome: Every curriculum and question package offered at launch has complete, reviewed content and predictable access behavior.

tasks.title: Select the first content offer
work: Choose one institute segment, class/program, subjects, language and supported assessment types.
List exact chapters/topics and exam bundles promised to pilot users.
Identify institute-owned versus platform-licensed content and its accountable reviewer.
acceptance: A finite pilot inventory exists; unsupported curricula/families are absent from the offer.
Each offered topic has a minimum content quantity and review standard agreed by the academic lead.
verification: Review the launch inventory with product, teachers and the academic owner.

tasks.title: Approve curriculum completeness and quality
work: Run catalog/content audits on the intended release data rather than demo totals.
Review correctness, explanations, difficulty, duplicates, accessibility of media and curriculum mapping.
Resolve empty active topics; record content source/rights and review dates.
acceptance: Every advertised topic meets the agreed inventory and editorial standards.
No known incorrect answer, unlicensed item or test placeholder remains in offered content.
verification: Retain topic coverage report, reviewer signoff and sampled scoring/rendering checks.

tasks.title: Separate customer content from test fixtures
work: Use explicit synthetic fixture identifiers and isolated QA tenants.
Prevent seeded QA names/questions/packages from appearing in customer discovery.
Provide dry-run inventory and exact fixture cleanup with ownership checks.
acceptance: Customer catalogs contain only approved content.
Automated tests clean only their own records and verify residue rather than accepting best-effort archive as purge.
verification: Compare pre/post catalog inventory and execute one disposable lifecycle cleanup.

tasks.title: Certify shared content acquisition
work: Run teacher request → institute/platform approval → local link → exam attach/publish.
Verify licensed copy edit restrictions and plain-language requested/approved/linked states.
Test duplicate requests, matching scope and entitlement expiry/revocation/quota exhaustion.
acceptance: A valid institute can use the purchased package; an invalid one cannot bypass restrictions.
The treatment of already-published exams after expiry/revocation is explicit and regression-tested.
verification: Execute direct API and populated browser package/entitlement tests with reconciliation of usage.

tasks.title: Set content maintenance ownership
work: Define how teachers report incorrect questions and how reviewers resolve them.
Version corrections so existing attempt/result interpretation remains stable.
Set periodic content review and catalog expansion criteria.
acceptance: A reported content defect has an owner and a traceable correction path.
Question edits do not silently change the meaning or score of past attempts.
verification: Rehearse one synthetic content correction and inspect historical attempt/result behavior.

workstreams.title: Payments and entitlements
workstreams.support: Founder, web/mobile engineer, finance operations and QA
workstreams.depends: D06 commercial offer and provider; D07 native purchase model; W02 and W05 access/content contracts
workstreams.outcome: A successful verified purchase grants the right access once, and failed, expired or refunded transactions are handled predictably.

tasks.title: Freeze the commercial contract
tasks.gate: Pilot billing decision; complete commercial contract before paid launch
work: Choose institute invoicing versus direct student purchases and the first paid offer.
Define price/currency, tax/invoice responsibility, renewal, cancellation, refund and entitlement rules with accountable business owners.
Decide native app purchase/consumption behavior after reviewing current store/provider requirements; do not assume a web checkout link is permitted.
acceptance: Each sales channel has a documented supported purchase path and entitlement owner.
Pilot manual settlement, if used, is explicit and does not masquerade as automated payment.
verification: Review the commercial state diagram and sample purchase/refund records.
tasks.status: Complete for pilot; paid offer deferred

tasks.title: Implement provider payment verification
work: Create provider orders on the server and use approved client checkout components.
Verify callback signatures, amounts, currency, order ownership and event replay/idempotency.
Keep provider secrets server-side and isolate sandbox from live configuration.
acceptance: Only verified settlement can grant paid access.
Repeated callbacks and client retries do not create duplicate ledger credits or subscriptions.
verification: Run signed/invalid/duplicate/out-of-order sandbox webhook and checkout cases.

tasks.title: Make entitlement lifecycle consistent
work: Apply purchase activation, allowance consumption, renewal, expiry, cancellation and refund/revocation to the chosen policies.
Keep exam purchase eligibility separate from institute question-bank authoring rights.
Use the same authoritative decisions on student web and native clients.
acceptance: The student sees the same current balance, subscription and exam access on all supported devices.
A locked or exhausted resource cannot be started via direct API.
verification: Compare API/ledger/subscription state through purchase, use, expiry and reversal fixtures.

tasks.title: Complete finance and support operations
work: Add reconciliation, order lookup, transaction audit, refund/cancellation handling and safe support tools.
Represent pending, failed, abandoned, disputed and refunded states truthfully.
Require audited operator action and prevent privilege escalation in manual adjustments.
acceptance: Finance can reconcile provider transactions to internal records and explain discrepancies.
Support can resolve a purchase without duplicate grants or undocumented balance changes.
verification: Rehearse failed settlement, late callback, refund and reconciliation mismatch in sandbox.

tasks.title: Approve a controlled paid release
work: Execute the full purchase → unlock → exam → result path on the attested release.
Use an authorized controlled live transaction only after provider setup and business approval.
Verify receipts/support contacts and customer cancellation/refund guidance.
acceptance: Provider and internal records agree; access is granted exactly once.
No unresolved critical payment or entitlement defect remains.
verification: Retain redacted transaction/reconciliation evidence and finance signoff.

workstreams.title: Onboarding and customer trust
workstreams.support: Backend engineer, founder and support/content owners
workstreams.depends: D01 customer scope, D06 offer and W02 role/access contract
workstreams.outcome: Customers understand the offer, can enter and recover their account, and have clear support/privacy procedures.

tasks.title: Complete role onboarding and first use
work: Define assisted institute provisioning plus public student/teacher/parent web onboarding where included.
Route accounts to the correct profile-completion and first-use task.
On native apps accept student accounts only; give other roles a clear web destination without exposing their protected data.
acceptance: An incomplete profile cannot strand a user or route them into another role.
A newly provisioned pilot student can reach their first assigned exam.
verification: Run fresh-account onboarding and invalid/incomplete-role cases on web; native cases join W08.03.

tasks.title: Add account recovery
tasks.gate: Public self-serve; assisted fallback acceptable for pilot
work: Implement secure time-limited, single-use password reset with neutral account-existence messaging and rate limits.
Handle delivery failure, expiry, reuse and session invalidation consistently.
Document a verified support recovery fallback for pilot users.
acceptance: A legitimate user can recover access; an attacker cannot enumerate or take over accounts via recovery.
Recovery behavior is consistent across student web and native entry points.
verification: Test expired/replayed tokens, wrong identity, throttling, provider delivery failure and post-reset sessions.

tasks.title: Publish customer policies and support routes
work: Create usable privacy/terms/support destinations and link them from signup, footer and native settings.
Assign owners for child/guardian handling, data export/deletion, retention, complaints and payment terms appropriate to the launch.
Define student deletion versus institute academic record retention with the responsible business/legal reviewers.
acceptance: Policy and support links resolve; the named procedures have an accountable operator.
Requests can be fulfilled without unauthorized data exposure or inconsistent deletion claims.
verification: Check routes and mobile links; rehearse synthetic export/deletion/support requests.

tasks.title: Replace internal marketing content
work: Replace design commentary and generic positioning with actual first-segment outcomes and supported workflows.
Substantiate or remove user counts, satisfaction percentages and testimonials.
Provide a concrete institute contact/demo journey or supported student checkout; do not label an undefined offer a free trial.
acceptance: Every visible claim has supporting business evidence or is removed.
Primary calls to action reach a working, appropriately scoped destination.
verification: Review landing, pricing, resources, contact and signup on desktop/mobile; test every primary conversion link.

tasks.title: Measure activation and support friction
work: Instrument minimal privacy-reviewed events for signup/profile completion, first assigned exam, start, save failure, submit and support request. [Complete]
Use role/platform and release identity to distinguish web, Android and iOS failures without collecting answer text or credentials. [Complete]
Prepare an activation/support dashboard and a weekly owner review. [Complete]

Observe unfamiliar pilot users completing teacher question find/add, student wallet-history and learner signup/first-action tasks without coaching; record time, errors and abandonment points. [Pending]
acceptance: The team can identify where pilot users stop and which failures affect assessment completion.
Event collection respects the published data practices.
verification: Run a synthetic journey and reconcile expected events; inspect payloads for sensitive fields. [Complete]
Run the W07 unfamiliar-user observation and attach reviewed session results. [Pending]

workstreams.title: Student Android and iOS
workstreams.support: Backend engineer, device QA, designer and product owner
workstreams.effort: 10–18 engineering days plus account and store review lead time
workstreams.depends: Student-only scope fixed; W03 runtime, W07 onboarding/policies, W01 HTTPS, W09 release QA and D07 purchase model
workstreams.outcome: Signed Android and iOS student apps safely complete the same assessment and learning journey as student web.

tasks.title: Establish app identities and distribution
work: Assign approved student-app name, Android package, iOS bundle identifier and owned developer accounts.
Use existing authorized signing identities or provision them through the account owner; keep credentials out of source/evidence.
Set isolated preview/production HTTPS configuration and verify release policy checks and build provenance.
acceptance: Placeholder identities are gone from distributable builds.
Android/iOS builds are signed for the intended distribution channel and target the attested HTTPS API.
verification: Inspect release metadata, signing and embedded endpoints without printing secrets; install both beta builds.
tasks.status: Blocked on identities, owned accounts and authorized signing

tasks.title: Simplify the student app experience
work: Prioritize dashboard/assigned exams, attempts, results/review, practice/weak areas, profile and help.
Keep wallet/subscriptions visible only when the channel purchase/consumption model is ready; include enabled notifications access/preferences.
Handle long lists, small screens, font scaling, equations/media and error states; include no admin, institute, teacher or parent workspace.
acceptance: Core student tasks remain reachable without large introductory blocks or unbounded histories.
Unsupported role login cannot expose a native privileged workspace.
verification: Review small Android/iPhone screens, accessibility scaling, non-student sessions and seeded large histories.
tasks.status: In progress; core routes exist, device/accessibility matrix open

tasks.title: Prove the signed exam and recovery journey
work: Run fresh student login/onboarding, exam discovery/detail/eligibility, start, answer saves, submit, results and review on signed Android and iOS builds.
During an actual in-progress attempt test background/foreground, kill/relaunch, token expiry, network loss, low-memory restart and interrupted submission.
Test timing, resume, accessibility accommodations and supported question/media types.
acceptance: Acknowledged answers survive restart; server time and access policies remain authoritative.
A real active attempt is tested; an empty Attempts screen is not accepted as runtime proof.
verification: Retain real-device/emulator/simulator matrices with OS/build/API identities, saved-answer assertions and duplicate-submit checks.
tasks.status: In progress; local builds and reliability fixes passed, signed journey open

tasks.title: Complete native security and service behavior
work: Verify secure token storage, logout/session revocation, protected media, screenshot/log privacy and deep-link authorization.
If push is included, handle permission denial, expired token, logout token removal, child-safe message content and deep links.
Verify account recovery/deletion/help links and app purchase behavior according to D07 and current channel rules.
acceptance: No token, credential or sensitive learner payload leaks through app-owned logs or notification text.
Notifications/deep links never bypass login, learner ownership or result publication rules.
verification: Run direct API ownership probes plus signed-device session/deep-link/permission tests.
tasks.status: In progress; secure storage/configuration inspected, signed-device probes open

tasks.title: Prepare store submissions and student beta
work: Prepare store descriptions/screenshots, support URLs, privacy/data declarations, age/content ratings and review access matching actual behavior.
Use internal/beta distribution for both platforms; monitor crashes, failed saves and student completion.
Prepare upgrade compatibility and a rollback/disable strategy for unsafe app/API combinations.
acceptance: Both platforms complete beta acceptance without unresolved critical runtime defects.
Store submission materials match the student-only app and its purchase/data behavior.
verification: Complete signed Android/iOS release checklist; retain device results and beta cohort feedback. Store approval timing remains external.

workstreams.title: Reliability and release QA
workstreams.depends: W01 candidate identity and included W02–W08 capabilities
workstreams.outcome: Every shipped promise has current test evidence, measured operating limits and a demonstrated recovery path.

tasks.title: Freeze the release test matrix
work: Map each included role journey and audit finding to a test or manual acceptance check.
Separate current pass/fail, deferred feature, unverified coverage and intermittent cases.
Bind evidence to release SHA/environment/device; keep browser/API/database and human UAT claims distinct.
acceptance: The launch checklist has no ambiguous green result based only on source/test existence.
Every included high-risk behavior has an owner and verification path.
verification: Review matrix completeness against W01–W10 and the 26 audit findings.

tasks.title: Validate long sessions and outages
work: Run full-duration exam sessions through refresh expiry, client reload, API interruption and delayed/retried saves/submits.
Verify scheduled processing and timed expiry under the actual runtime topology.
Test grace/late-submit behavior, randomization continuity and accommodations for included policies.
acceptance: No acknowledged answer is lost and no retry changes final score or access consumption incorrectly.
Failure/recovery messages tell users what happened and what to do.
verification: Use deterministic answer fixtures and compare persisted state before/after each interruption.
tasks.status: In progress; Docker recovery passed, stage duration pending

tasks.title: Measure capacity for the sold cohort
work: Product/operations agree expected concurrent students, start burst, save cadence, duration and submit burst.
Use representative data, production-like services and isolated synthetic load; observe database, queues/workers if present and application latency.

Proposed starting acceptance: p95 start/save/submit under 2 seconds, under 1 percent unexpected request errors, zero lost acknowledged answers or incorrect results, with a 1.5× target-cohort headroom run. Confirm these targets before testing.
acceptance: A measured capacity envelope and cost/scale limit support the promised cohort.
If targets fail, tune and rerun or reduce admitted cohort; do not extrapolate from localhost timings.
verification: Retain workload, infrastructure, latency/error distributions and data-integrity results.

tasks.title: Prove backup restore and incident response
work: Restore the database and relevant media into an isolated environment; verify secrets are not copied into artifacts.
Agree recovery point/time targets and rehearse data recovery and an application rollback.
Wire observable exam/save/payment failures and service health to a reachable owner with an escalation runbook.
acceptance: Recovery meets the agreed targets and restored exams/results remain consistent.
A synthetic incident triggers an actionable alert and reaches the designated responder.
verification: Record restore/rollback timings, checksums where appropriate, incident timeline and final health checks.

tasks.title: Run final candidate regression
work: Run core backend and browser packs plus included cross-browser/accessibility and native packs.
Add commerce/shared-library/descriptive cases only when those features enter the offer; disable deferred routes/actions.
Triage critical, high and cosmetic defects with explicit owners; rerun affected tests after fixes.
acceptance: Zero unresolved critical defects or high defects affecting assessment correctness, access/privacy, paid grants or required accessibility.
Go/no-go records exact artifact identity, exclusions, capacity and recovery evidence.
verification: Publish a release summary with failure evidence and exclusions; a rerun pass does not erase unresolved intermittent failures.
tasks.status: In progress; local candidate checkpoint passed

workstreams.title: Pilot and market rollout
workstreams.support: Customer success, academic lead, QA and engineering lead
workstreams.effort: 2–4 engineering support days plus two real assessment cycles
workstreams.depends: Pilot gates across W01–W05, W07 and W09
workstreams.outcome: A small group of real institutes can operate the product successfully before sales, content and student-app scope expands.

tasks.title: Choose design partners and pilot promises
work: Proposed initial cohort: 2–3 institutes, one curriculum, objective exams and assisted onboarding. Confirm actual learner numbers/capacity in W09.03.
Agree pilot duration, contact, content ownership, support availability and known feature exclusions.
Provide a concise onboarding checklist for institute admins, teachers and students.
acceptance: Each pilot partner understands included features, limits and support channel.
Pilot setup does not promise public marketplace, automated payments or native roles that are outside scope.
verification: Review the offer and task checklist with each designated institute contact.

tasks.title: Run unfamiliar-user acceptance
work: Observe new admins import a roster and assign a teacher, teachers create/publish an exam, and students start/submit/review it.
Include parent linking/visibility only if parent is part of the pilot offer.
Record completion time, help requests, failed actions and misunderstood labels; fix the highest-impact friction.
acceptance: All required tasks can be completed; no critical access, scoring or answer-loss issue remains.

Proposed activation target: at least 80 percent of first-time participants complete their assigned core task without facilitator intervention. Confirm participant mix/sample size before interpreting the result.
verification: Retain anonymized task results and route-specific fixes rather than a general satisfaction score.

tasks.title: Approve and run the web pilot
work: Approve the exact candidate, capacity cap, support roster and recovery plan.
Run two real assessment cycles and review activation, completion, failed saves, content defects and support burden.
Pause enrollment and apply the incident runbook if correctness, access/privacy or saved-answer safety fails.
acceptance: Two cycles complete with zero unresolved critical incidents and reconciled scores/results.
Proposed completion target: at least 95 percent of started attempts reach a valid final state; investigate every technical non-completion. Confirm the target against pilot context.
verification: Review event/API/database evidence and institute feedback after each cycle.

tasks.title: Expand to paid web and student app betas
work: Offer paid self-serve web only after the relevant payment, public-eligibility and support gates pass.
Admit student Android/iOS beta users after W08.03; teacher/institute/admin/parent roles stay on web.
Expand one curriculum/cohort at a time within the measured capacity envelope.

Require W06.05 for paid checkout, W02.04 for cross-institute public exams, W05.04 for shared-package sales and W08.03 for student app beta; these gates apply only to the channel or feature being added.
acceptance: Every new sales/channel promise has an owner and current evidence.
Student apps can use the approved access model without requiring native operator workflows.
